subject: Action: PO tag reconciliation and spend guard — Northworks onboarding
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northworks.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@northworks.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO request: Northworks SOW onboarding & spend cap

Hi Hannah / Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We're ready to get procurement started so our onboarding engineering time can be scheduled. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood issue a provisional PO/# and set a spend cap of $95,000 for the next 90 days (we plan to ramp usage and will confirm any lift with our procurement team)?
2) Attached is the updated line item CSV (northworks_onboard_lineitems_v2.csv). There are three discrete SKUs: infra-hours, model-inference-units, and support-hours. We realized earlier that the SOW totals didn't map cleanly to your ledger tags — can procurement confirm the PO will preserve per-line spend tracking (we need separate reporting on infra vs support)?

We have the signed SOW (attached). The AP team is on copy for invoice routing once the PO is live. If you need a vendor code, our company tax id and remittance details are in the SOW.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we have an onboarding session scheduled for 2026-09-03 and would like PO confirmation before then.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships
Northworks

Attachments: northworks_onboard_lineitems_v2.csv (text/csv), requested_sow.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO request: Northworks SOW onboarding & spend cap

Thanks Ethan — looping in Procurement (Monica) and Purref ops (Priyom) to tag this and confirm timing. A couple quick clarifying items:

- Do you need the spend cap applied at the account level or the PO/series level? (Account-level caps are easier to lift later; PO-level caps are stricter.)
- Are the three SKUs expected to be billed as distinct invoice lines or aggregated per month? Your CSV looks line-itemized but wanted to confirm.

Monica / Priyom — can you take point on issuing a provisional PO and ensure the line items map to ledger tags (infra-hours -> INFRA, inference-units -> INFER, support-hours -> SUPPORT)? If there are any temporary workarounds required to preserve reporting, please flag them.

Ethan — we'll aim to get a provisional PO number back to you within one business day assuming the attached CSV is final.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northworks.com>, Finance AP <ap@northworks.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO request: Northworks SOW onboarding & spend cap

Hi all,

Reviewed the CSV. Two quick items before we issue:

- Line item normalization: the "model-inference-units" SKU currently has three rate bands in your file (0-10k, 10k-50k, >50k). Our PO system prefers explicit separate lines for each band. Can you confirm the unit rates for each band and whether you want them as three discrete line items on the PO?
- Spend cap scope: Hannah — account-level cap will allow them to use multiple POs under the same cap if needed; PO-level will restrict to the issued PO only. Recommend PO-level cap for clearer audit trail given this is first 90-day onboarding.

I'll prepare a provisional PO stub and a suggested line mapping (see attached po_stub_NW-2026-08-01.xlsx). If Priyom can confirm the accounting code mapping (INFRA / INFER / SUPPORT) we can enter this into the provisioning queue and generate a PO number.

ETA: I can create the provisional PO today if we get confirmation on the bands and accounting codes by EOD.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: po_stub_NW-2026-08-01.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northworks.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO request: Northworks SOW onboarding & spend cap

Thanks Monica — apologies for the ambiguity. Confirming details below so you can proceed:

- Yes, please create three discrete line items for the inference bands. Unit rates (USD): 0-10k = $0.045/unit, 10k-50k = $0.038/unit, >50k = $0.031/unit.
- Invoice rules: infra-hours billed monthly in arrears; inference-units billed weekly as usage; support-hours billed monthly.
- We want PO-level spend cap of $95,000 for the initial 90-day window.
- Accounting codes: INFRA -> 4301, INFER -> 4302, SUPPORT -> 4303.

I've uploaded an updated CSV with explicit band rows to the Drive link Hannah shared and re-attached a clean file to this message. Also sending this to our AP team for fast invoice routing. If you can issue a provisional PO number before Monday 09/31 (note: typo — they meant 09/01), that would be ideal — we have the kickoff on 09/03.

Ethan

Attachments: northworks_onboard_lineitems_v2.csv (updated)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Finance AP <ap@northworks.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO request: Northworks SOW onboarding & spend cap

Ethan — thanks for the fast follow. Monica / Priyom have everything needed.

Action summary and next steps:

- Provisional PO issued: PO-NW-2026-08-001 (provisional). This will be visible in vendor portal and can be used for invoice routing.
- Spend cap: $95,000 applied at the PO-level for 90 days, expires 2026-11-28T23:59:00-08:00 unless renewed.
- Line items: three separate inference-band lines + infra-hours + support-hours created per Monica's stub; accounting codes set to 4301 / 4302 / 4303.
- Reporting: Priyom will add per-line tagging so your finance team can extract infra vs support spend; monthly ledger reports will be shared automatically.

Monica — please attach the finalized PO record to the vendor portal and flag any downstream ticket (billing or ops) if you see mapping issues. Priyom — can you confirm the ledger export cadence (weekly or monthly) and whether you'd like the initial transfer to include a manual CSV for Northworks?

Ethan — I've also sent the DocuSign link for the final SOW to your account; AP is on copy and will confirm invoice instructions. Let us know if anything breaks during kickoff.

Thanks,
Hannah
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO-NW-2026-08-001 (system record), https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Onboarding/Northworks/Final-PO
